page.title: Progress
page.description: Mark the tricks you already have, the ones you are practicing and the ones you want to learn. Your progress is saved only in this browser.

summary.title: Your progress
summary.empty: You have not marked any trick yet. Use the buttons on each trick to get started.

lists.title: Marked tricks
lists.description: Your tricks by status, with a link to each detail.
lists.errorTitle: We could not load your tricks
lists.errorDescription: There was a problem resolving the marked tricks. Please try again.
lists.learnedEmpty: You have not marked any trick as learned yet.
lists.inProgressEmpty: You have not marked any trick in progress yet.
lists.wantEmpty: You have not marked any trick to learn yet.
lists.allEmptyTitle: You have not marked any trick yet
lists.allEmptyDescription: Use the buttons on each trick to mark them and see them here grouped by status.

savedCombos.title: Your combos
savedCombos.description: Edit, export or delete the combos you saved from the generator. They are saved only in this browser.
savedCombos.emptyTitle: You have not saved any combo yet
savedCombos.emptyDescription: Generate a combo and press Save to see it here.
savedCombos.limitReached: You reached the maximum of 5 saved combos. Edit or delete one to save another.
savedCombos.exportError: We could not export the combo.
savedCombos.deleteDescription: This combo will be removed from this browser. This action cannot be undone.
savedCombos.deleteDescriptionNamed: "{title}" will be removed from this browser. This action cannot be undone.
savedCombos.titleRequired: Write a title for the combo.
savedCombos.saveError: We could not save the changes.

export.title: Export and import
export.description: Save your progress to a JSON file or restore it from a file. Progress lives only in this browser.
export.importError: The file does not contain valid progress.
export.deleteDescription: All marks saved in this browser will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
